history.name: Nothing is stranded across a page break
history.description: An area or sub-section heading is never left alone at the foot of a page, and no feature is split across two — each heading travels with the first entry beneath it, and the rules between entries are worked out over the real running order so a separator can't go missing where a section starts.
history.dev_notes: The .cat-open / .sub-open wrappers plus markSeams(), which decides no-line over the category's true row order rather than leaving it to :last-child.
